name: geomean
expr: g1 = geomean([1 2 3 4 5]); gM = geomean(M); gd = geomean(M, 2);
comment: Sig g=geomean(X[,dim]): geometric mean = exp(mean(log x)). Vector geomean([1 2 3 4 5])=2.605171. Matrix default per-column: geomean(magic(4)) = [7.325683 6.814158 7.208434 5.943656]. dim=2 per-row: geomean(magic(4),2) = [5.943656 8.144476 ...].
